🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 4)
Channel: alert-runtime-monitoring  •  bug-type guess: env  •  alerts in group: 1
_(late triage — hourly cron stalled ~13h; last poll cycle 2026-05-27 22:08Z)_

*Symptoms:*
  • ms-account-api `Database Connection Opening Failed` → `Inventory Management Traits Retrieval Failed` recurring 2x (04:33:47Z, 04:47:53Z) — isolated, no cascade
  • scattered noise: oauth client errors (3x, generic bad/expired token), runtime-api empty-states for account `devriescpaapc` (1x), email feature-flag fetch (1x)

*Context:* error volume is BELOW baseline (39 vs 216 in the same window 24h ago). runtime-core p95 healthy (peak 1.1s) — NOT ki-24. No deploys. No monitor threshold transition at 04:34Z; this is a Datadog Error-Tracking "new issue to review" notification.

*Likely cause:* transient ms-account-api DB-connection-open hiccup (pool or single tenant DB momentarily unreachable). devriescpaapc not_found on prod1/prod2.
*Suggested next action:* monitor — file a defect for ms-account-api DB-connection-open failures if frequency climbs. Not a page.

*Source alert (1 total):*
  • https://method-software.slack.com/archives/C063V5HTTFU/p1779942897642019  (alert-runtime-monitoring, 04:34 UTC)

*Evidence:*
  • DD monitors: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/227951254 — "New issue to review" (Alert, Error Tracking)
  • DD metric (runtime-core p95, healthy): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env:prod,service:runtime-core-api&exp_agg=p95&start=1779926400&end=1779945000
  • Kibana (ms-account DB connection): https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-05-28T04:00:00Z',to:'2026-05-28T05:00:00Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'level:Error and "Database Connection Opening Failed"'))
  • Investigation: docs/investigations/2026-05-28-eafc8c74d334912d.md

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
Occurrence #60 overall → every-10th *resurface* (≈55 in the last 7 days). Status: *needs-ops-decision*.

ms-gateway-api Ocelot timeouts proxying to `microservices.methodlocal.int`. Confirmed *chronic* this window: gateway `Ocelot.Responder.Middleware` `RequestTimedOutError` Warnings = 82 (12:35–12:45Z) vs 104 24h-ago (−21%, *below* baseline → steady-state, not a regression). Monitor 77419271 last fired 12:43:11Z (−1s to the satellite alert).

Playbook: 1) confirm chronic baseline (done: −21%) → no new incident. 2) aggregate Ocelot timeouts by RequestPath. 3) *check `ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota` first* (DNS bursts present as Ocelot timeouts). 4) identify slow downstream microservice via `ocelot.*.json`. 5) fix decision tree: raise per-route Ocelot timeout / scale microservices IIS pool / profile upstream (sync-util, preferences, account).
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (2 total):
  • https://method-software.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1779972013077259  (alert-frontend-errors, 12:40 UTC)
  • https://method-software.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1779972192370169  (alert-frontend-errors, 12:43 UTC)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor 77419271: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271 — "Unusual number of XHR errors for account"
  • Kibana (gateway Ocelot timeouts): https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-05-28T12:35:00.000Z',to:'2026-05-28T12:45:00.000Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'fields.Application%3A%22gateway%22%20AND%20level%3AWarning%20AND%20message%3A%2ARequestTimedOutError%2A'))

🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 5)
Channel: alert-system  •  bug-type guess: data/env  •  alerts in group: 1 (+2 sibling groups, same incident)

Symptoms:
  - runtime-core-api 5XX monitor *70171778* tripped (>30 5XX in 5m by service, 13:08:38Z). runtime-core-api was the dominant service in DD APM 5XX-by-service (~25 of ~36 across all services, 12:55–13:13Z).
  - ES runtime-core-api Errors = 53 vs 33 24h-ago (+60%, modest absolute). Dominated by chronic `Expiring session token failed` ×36 and `Bad count filter on ribbonId` ×11; only a handful of real 5XX: `Redis operation cancelled` ×3, SQL concurrent-access/connection ×1, `EstimateLine` field-delete rolled back (db `gandbsheds`) ×1, `operation was canceled` ×1.
  - Accounts spread, no concentration: appenninofoodusa, tristateelevator2, excelpoolservice, gandbsheds, carlsondockandbarge. All unresolvable for user-count (prod3–5 clusters unconfigured — chronic gap).

Trace IDs: none surfaced (RequestId not populated in runtime error docs)
Likely cause: *transient* — mostly chronic session-token 500s tipping the 5XX monitor just over 30, plus a few transient SQL/Redis cancellations. No deploy (runtime-core unchanged since 2026-05-06). NOT `ki-2026-05-24` RTC-p95 (that's latency-only, zero-error) and NOT `ki-2026-05-21` (frontend/gateway).
Suggested next action: *monitor* (likely transient). If `Bad count filter on ribbonId` recurs across cycles, file a defect on the runtime grid count-filter path.

Cross-channel: the same elevation also surfaced as error-tracking new-issues on #alert-system (`8ccc3dd3`, 13:04Z) and #alert-runtime-monitoring (`86ec52c4`, 13:07Z) — consolidated into this one DM (those two suppressed to actionable).
